messages:
miguel: nightly eval flagged a regression on the INT8 profile for rwi-7b-v2 — big drop on the math & instruction promptsets, worth a quick triage

eval-bot: nightly-run 1767801200 completed
eval-bot: job_id=nr-2026-03-18-07, model=rwi-7b-v2(float) baseline vs rwi-7b-v2-int8
eval-bot: metrics delta: avg_EM -5.2%, perplexity +12%, rougeL -3.1

miguel: this looks like a calibration/quant mismatch, not model weight drift. INT8 only; FP16 baseline stable.

asha: do we have the calibration representative set that was used for this INT8 profile? maybe it underrepresented math/instruction tokens.

sam: checking quant config: method=per_tensor symmetric, percentile_clip=99.9, calibr_samples=2048

sam: per_tensor symmetric is cheap but fragile for attention outliers — might need per_channel or lower clip percentile for kv layers

kevin: any per-layer scale spikes in the calibr logs? last week we saw kv_proj with a huge outlier on a couple tokens

miguel: paste from calibr.log: "layer: kv_proj, max_abs=3.4e2, median_abs=1.2, ratio=283"

asha: that ratio will cause saturation under symmetric per-tensor. Two quick mitigations: expand the reprset to include those token patterns, or switch to per-channel for problematic linears.

sam: quick repro command to run locally:

sam: ```bash
sam: python -m rwi.quant.run_calib --model rwi-7b-v2 --reprset data/reprsets/nightly_math_instr.json --samples 8192 --method per_channel
sam: ```

kevin: try also percentile_clip=99.5 and per-channel for kv and out_proj only; keep other layers per_tensor to limit perf hit.

asha: @miguel can you collect the failing prompt ids from the nightly report and drop them into a mini repro set? need to see if failures concentrate on a few prompts or are broad.

miguel: added failing_prompt_ids: [2345, 2348, 2401, 2410] to /tmp/triage/1767801234/; queued repro on g4dn.

eval-bot: quick eval on repro set (current int8 profile): EM drop -6.1% vs float — repro confirmed.

sam: next steps plan:
sam: 1) run per-channel calibration for linear layers with samples=8192
sam: 2) run targeted calibration with augmented reprset (include the failing prompts)
sam: 3) if still bad, test asymmetric quant or KLD clipping

kevin: owners: sam=per-channel runs, asha=reprset augmentation, miguel=result collation + perf tradeoff check.

miguel: timeline: aim to have new calibration artifacts and a canary profile within ~6 hours; if EM drop <=1% and latency hit <3% we can stage rollout.

asha: adding canary gating note to the ticket. also add safety prompt eval to ensure instruction-following preserved.

sam: will post results here once runs complete. tagging :eyes:

kevin: also flagging to eng-sre if we need temporary capacity to run larger calibr samples.

miguel: thanks team — will follow up with logs, new profile id, and perf numbers once the runs finish :thumbsup:
